headline: Global AI Shares Stabilize in Muted Trading Following Market Slump
summary: Trading in artificial intelligence technology shares quieted following a steep market slump in the previous session, as investors reassessed equity market valuations.
why: Fluctuations in technology and AI hardware market valuations strongly sway benchmark stock indices worldwide.

impacts.name: S&P 500 Index
impacts.why: Stock indices consolidated after selling momentum in tech shares eased.

why_moved: Trading volume and price swings slowed across AI technology shares after sharp sell-offs in the prior trading session.
